definition.rep: fraction of the row's 8-grams (blake2b-64 of ' '.join(8 tokens)) whose count over the parent set is > 1; rows under 8 tokens take 0 (e04_split.py lines 29-37)

token_classes.priority: a token overlapping a SYM span is SYM, else overlapping a DATE span is DATE, else NUM if it matches, else WORD

definition.M1: exclude: a SYM/DATE/NUM token matches nothing, so an 8-gram occurrence containing one never counts as repeated, and an untouched 8-gram counts only if it occurs untouched more than once in the parent; denominator unchanged (headline)
definition.M1_digit: M1 with exactly the tokens containing a Unicode digit masked
definition.M1_prime: M1's repeated 8-grams over the row's number of 8-grams with no masked token (0 if none)
definition.M2: placeholder: SYM/DATE/NUM tokens -> #sym/#date/#num, counts recomputed over the parent
definition.M2_A17: every Unicode digit -> '0' inside each token (e06_build.py A17_RULE), counts recomputed
